description: Show a compact progress card for an existing subscriber import. Reads immediately, then polls get_subscriber_import every five seconds for up to five minutes while running. Refresh resumes monitoring. Requires explicit companyId and importId. Does not start or retry an import. Other clients receive the import data.

companyId.description: Pinned target company ID from get_account.

name: monitor_subscriber_import

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `monitor_subscriber_import` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
